shellCommands.command: curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Products on sale" | sort -u

curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Products on sale\|Featured products" | sort -u; echo "---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -i "location\|x-nextjs"

curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K" > /tmp/prefetch_sale.rsc; wc -c /tmp/prefetch_sale.rsc; grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale" /tmp/prefetch_sale.rsc | sort -u

curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" > /tmp/nav_sale.rsc; wc -c /tmp/nav_sale.rsc; grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale" /tmp/nav_sale.rsc | sort -u

LOC=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); echo "LOC=$LOC"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100${LOC}" > /tmp/nav_sale.rsc; wc -c /tmp/nav_sale.rsc; grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale" /tmp/nav_sale.rsc | sort -u

LOC=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100${LOC}" > /tmp/auto_sale.rsc; wc -c /tmp/auto_sale.rsc; grep -o "Loading category\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale" /tmp/auto_sale.rsc | sort -u

curl -s -D - -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | head -8; echo ===; LOC=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); echo "LOC=$LOC"; curl -s -D - -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100${LOC}" -o /tmp/auto_sale.rsc | head -8; wc -c /tmp/auto_sale.rsc

LOC=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3100${LOC}" | grep -o "Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Featured products" | sort -u
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo stopped
